scope: One isolated iOS 27.1 Simulator direct Core ML synthetic mechanical check; no production model adoption.

v1.actualErrors: SDK 27.1 rejects Thread.isMainThread in lexical async contexts; the prediction overload selected there requires await. These actual compiler blockers supersede the earlier static-only review.

v2.fix: Synchronous nonisolated helper wrappers inspect the current thread and call the blocking prediction API from the same detached worker. No model/input/sequence/math/criterion change.

SDKWarningRetained.warning: incompatible-sysroot: macOS 27.0 sysroot while targeting arm64 iOS 17 Simulator
SDKWarningRetained.meaning: Successful build/runtime does not erase the warning or establish its cause or general compatibility.

runtime.CPU: CPU-only configuration requested and readback matched; not independent kernel proof.

modelAndInputs.artifact: Exact previously inspected official Apple MobileNetV2 INT8-LUT model
modelAndInputs.inputs: Same two fixed 224x224 procedural RGB8 patterns as the Mac probe, A then B then identical A. Explicit BGRA pixel-buffer conversion and active-row hash validation; embedded preprocessing retained, no external normalization.

schemaAndDuplicatePolicy.duplicate: crane is present at two positional labels but one dictionary key. Actual returned dictionary preserved; no separate scores, renormalization or merge rule invented. Sums remain descriptive.

unchangedFrozenCriteria.perVector: 1000 original unique keys, finite values in[0,1], span>1e-8

numericResult.independentReview: All 3,000 Float64 JSON/byte roundtrips, vector hashes, finite/range/span checks and ordered comparison math verified. Fourteen captured files match the retained container; all nine built/installed files and four resources match. Root independent readback agrees.

priorEvidence.meaning: This separate direct-model check neither diagnoses/fixes the earlier Vision failures nor establishes equality across Mac, iOS, handlers, wrappers, representations or backends. No cross-platform equality criterion was applied.

limits: Only these synthetic iOS 27.1 Simulator mechanics passed. No food/world-cuisine naming, unknown/nonfood quality, abstention/calibration, ingredients, portions, nutrition or insulin result.

No physical-device or network-isolated offline acceptance, general iOS portability, performance/final-package, training, model adoption or submission-readiness acceptance. Model and compiled artifacts remain outside the repository.
Prior embedded licensing evidence remains evidence to review, not legal assurance, third-party image permission or redistribution approval.
privacy: No model/compiled files, RGB images, probability vectors, raw private errors/paths, target UUIDs or account identifiers copied here.
